text: Name the three architectural advantages of cellular over Wi-Fi.
choices: Higher power, better antennas, more spectrum
Licensed spectrum, scheduled rather than contended access, and network-controlled mobility
Lower latency, higher throughput, better range
explanation: These explain the performance difference more than the radio technology does. A cellular base station assigns transmission opportunities with knowledge of everyone's queue and channel quality; Wi-Fi's CSMA/CA is a polite free-for-all.
